goal: Establish the repository Better Plan workspace and current plan inventory.
description: Create docs/plan/README.md, docs/plan/Manifest.json, and per-plan Checkpoints.json files so active plans, migration plans, rollups, and report evidence have one validated index.

acceptance_criteria.text: docs/plan/README.md defines the boundary between active plans, rollups, report evidence, and Better Plan state.
docs/plan/Manifest.json lists every current plan group identified from docs/plan, docs/plan/reports, and docs/rollups.

goal: Keep plan documents and generated indexes consistent after planning changes.
description: Run manifest validation, docs index generation, docs audit, and lifecycle checks after plan-document changes; update the owning rollup or runbook when a plan status changes.

acceptance_criteria.text: python scripts/manifest_tool.py validate docs/plan passes after every Better Plan edit.
python scripts/docs-index.py --write is run when docs/plan or generated documentation inventories change.
python scripts/docs-audit.py and python scripts/docs-lifecycle.py validate pass before plan governance changes are accepted.
